messages.subject: Discount
messages.body:
Hi,

We had our first rental with you in August and were told we'd be getting the usual discount on our account going forward. Could you confirm whether it's been applied?

Regards,
Insinööritoimisto Vuolle Oy

messages.subject: Re: Discount
messages.body:
Hi,

I've had a look but I'd need a few more details before I can help. Which discount are you referring to, and for which booking? Once I know that I can check what's on your account.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Discount
messages.body:
Marko,

Quick one - is there an 18m articulated boom lift available? We may need one for a project coming up.

Insinööritoimisto Vuolle Oy
